items.question: Trong câu "Node.js takes the same JavaScript engine that Chrome uses (V8) and lets it run outside the browser, directly on your computer or on a server.", từ "engine" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Node.js takes the same JavaScript engine that Chrome uses (V8) and lets it run outside the browser, directly on your computer or on a server.", what does "engine" (noun) mean?
options: bộ máy xử lý (phần mềm chạy code)
công cụ tìm kiếm trên web
optionsEn: the software core that runs code
items.explanation: engine /ˈen.dʒɪn/ (danh từ): bộ máy xử lý (phần mềm chạy code). "JavaScript engine" = bộ máy chạy JavaScript; V8 là engine của Chrome và Node.js. Nghĩa gốc là động cơ.
items.explanationEn: engine /ˈen.dʒɪn/ (noun): the software core that runs code. A "JavaScript engine" runs JavaScript code; V8 powers Chrome and Node.js. The literal sense is a motor.

items.question: Trong câu "So even a "pure frontend" project needs Node.js on the developer's machine: the dev server, the bundler and the test runner are all Node programs.", từ "bundler" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "So even a "pure frontend" project needs Node.js on the developer's machine: the dev server, the bundler and the test runner are all Node programs.", what does "bundler" (noun) mean?
options: máy chủ lưu trữ file tĩnh
công cụ đóng gói nhiều file code thành ít file
công cụ kiểm tra lỗi chính tả
optionsEn: a person who ties goods into bundles
a server that stores static files
a tool that packs many code files into a few
a tool that checks spelling mistakes
items.explanation: bundler /ˈbʌn.dlər/ (danh từ): công cụ đóng gói nhiều file code thành ít file. Vite, webpack là các bundler. Động từ gốc: bundle (đóng gói, gom lại).
items.explanationEn: bundler /ˈbʌn.dlər/ (noun): a tool that packs many code files into a few. Vite and webpack are bundlers. Base verb: bundle (to pack together).

items.question: Trong câu "Node.js releases new major versions regularly.", từ "release" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Node.js releases new major versions regularly.", what does "release" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to make a new version available
items.explanation: release /rɪˈliːs/ (động từ): phát hành (ra phiên bản mới). Danh từ cùng dạng: a release (một bản phát hành). "Release notes" = ghi chú phát hành.
items.explanationEn: release /rɪˈliːs/ (verb): to make a new version available. Same-form noun: a release. "Release notes" describe what changed in a version.

items.question: Trong câu "The ones marked LTS (Long-Term Support; so far the even-numbered ones such as 20, 22 and 24) receive bug and security fixes for about three years, so companies standardise on them.", từ "standardise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The ones marked LTS (Long-Term Support; so far the even-numbered ones such as 20, 22 and 24) receive bug and security fixes for about three years, so companies standardise on them.", what does "standardise" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to adopt as the common standard
items.explanation: standardise /ˈstæn.də.daɪz/ (động từ): thống nhất dùng làm chuẩn. "Standardise on X" = thống nhất chọn X cho cả tổ chức. Kiểu Mỹ: standardize.
items.explanationEn: standardise /ˈstæn.də.daɪz/ (verb): to adopt as the common standard. "Standardise on X" means everyone agrees to use X. US spelling: standardize.

items.question: Trong câu "Always install the version labelled LTS on nodejs.org.", từ "label" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Always install the version labelled LTS on nodejs.org.", what does "label" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to stick a stamp on a parcel
items.explanation: label /ˈleɪ.bəl/ (động từ): gắn nhãn, đánh dấu. Danh từ: a label (nhãn). Trong Jira, label dùng để phân loại ticket.
items.explanationEn: label /ˈleɪ.bəl/ (verb): to mark with a tag. Noun: a label. In Jira, labels are used to group tickets.

items.question: Trong câu "When a bug only happens on one developer's laptop, a different Node version is one of the first suspects.", từ "suspect" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When a bug only happens on one developer's laptop, a different Node version is one of the first suspects.", what does "suspect" (noun) mean?
options: nghi phạm, thứ bị nghi là nguyên nhân
optionsEn: something thought to be the cause
items.explanation: suspect /ˈsʌs.pekt/ (danh từ): nghi phạm, thứ bị nghi là nguyên nhân. Danh từ /ˈsʌs.pekt/ nhấn âm đầu; động từ /səˈspekt/ nhấn âm sau. Khi debug: "the first suspect" = nghi vấn đầu tiên.
items.explanationEn: suspect /ˈsʌs.pekt/ (noun): something thought to be the cause. Noun /ˈsʌs.pekt/ stresses the first syllable; the verb /səˈspekt/ stresses the second. In debugging, "the first suspect" is the likeliest cause.

items.question: Trong câu "A package (also called a library or dependency) is a folder of code someone else wrote, published so that anyone can reuse it.", từ "reuse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A package (also called a library or dependency) is a folder of code someone else wrote, published so that anyone can reuse it.", what does "reuse" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reuse /ˌriːˈjuːz/ (động từ): dùng lại. Tính từ: reusable (dùng lại được). "Code reuse" = tái sử dụng code.
items.explanationEn: reuse /ˌriːˈjuːz/ (verb): to use again. Adjective: reusable. "Code reuse" means using existing code again.

items.question: Trong câu "Think of cooking: you could make your own soy sauce, noodles and fish sauce from scratch, but a sensible cook buys good ingredients and spends their effort on the dish itself.", từ "from scratch" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Think of cooking: you could make your own soy sauce, noodles and fish sauce from scratch, but a sensible cook buys good ingredients and spends their effort on the dish itself.", what does "from scratch" (phrase) mean?
options: từ con số không, tự làm từ đầu
optionsEn: from the very beginning, with nothing ready-made
items.explanation: from scratch /frəm skrætʃ/ (cụm từ): từ con số không, tự làm từ đầu. "Build from scratch" = xây từ đầu. Scratch (danh từ) còn có nghĩa là vết xước.
items.explanationEn: from scratch /frəm skrætʃ/ (phrase): from the very beginning, with nothing ready-made. "Build from scratch" means start with nothing. Scratch (noun) also means a small cut or mark.

items.question: Trong câu "Think of cooking: you could make your own soy sauce, noodles and fish sauce from scratch, but a sensible cook buys good ingredients and spends their effort on the dish itself.", từ "ingredient" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Think of cooking: you could make your own soy sauce, noodles and fish sauce from scratch, but a sensible cook buys good ingredients and spends their effort on the dish itself.", what does "ingredient" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: one of the things a dish is made from
items.explanation: ingredient /ɪnˈɡriː.di.ənt/ (danh từ): nguyên liệu, thành phần. Nghĩa bóng: "key ingredient of success" = yếu tố then chốt. Bài này ví package như nguyên liệu mua sẵn.
items.explanationEn: ingredient /ɪnˈɡriː.di.ənt/ (noun): one of the things a dish is made from. Figurative: "a key ingredient of success". The topic compares packages to bought ingredients.

items.question: Trong câu "The public warehouse where packages live is the npm registry (registry.npmjs.org), with millions of packages.", từ "warehouse" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The public warehouse where packages live is the npm registry (registry.npmjs.org), with millions of packages.", what does "warehouse" (noun) mean?
options: kho dữ liệu phân tích (data warehouse)
optionsEn: a large building for storing goods
items.explanation: warehouse /ˈweə.haʊs/ (danh từ): nhà kho, kho hàng. Trong IT còn có "data warehouse" = kho dữ liệu để phân tích; ở đây là nghĩa ví von kho hàng.
items.explanationEn: warehouse /ˈweə.haʊs/ (noun): a large building for storing goods. IT also uses "data warehouse" for an analytics store; here it is a plain metaphor for a store of goods.

items.question: Trong câu "These indirect ones are transitive dependencies, and every one of them is code your product ships.", từ "transitive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "These indirect ones are transitive dependencies, and every one of them is code your product ships.", what does "transitive" (adjective) mean?
options: ngoại động (động từ có tân ngữ)
bắc cầu, gián tiếp qua trung gian
optionsEn: of a verb that takes an object
passed on through something in between
items.explanation: transitive /ˈtræn.sə.tɪv/ (tính từ): bắc cầu, gián tiếp qua trung gian. "Transitive dependency" = phụ thuộc bắc cầu: A cần B, B cần C thì C là phụ thuộc bắc cầu của A. Trong ngữ pháp: transitive verb = ngoại động từ.
items.explanationEn: transitive /ˈtræn.sə.tɪv/ (adjective): passed on through something in between. A "transitive dependency": A needs B, B needs C, so C is a transitive dependency of A. In grammar, a transitive verb takes an object.

items.question: Trong câu "These indirect ones are transitive dependencies, and every one of them is code your product ships.", từ "ship" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "These indirect ones are transitive dependencies, and every one of them is code your product ships.", what does "ship" (verb) mean?
options: phát hành, đưa (sản phẩm) tới người dùng
optionsEn: to deliver as part of a released product
items.explanation: ship /ʃɪp/ (động từ): phát hành, đưa (sản phẩm) tới người dùng. Trong phần mềm, "ship a feature" = đưa tính năng lên production. Nghĩa gốc: gửi hàng, vận chuyển.
items.explanationEn: ship /ʃɪp/ (verb): to deliver as part of a released product. In software, "ship a feature" means release it to users. The literal sense is to send goods.

items.question: Trong câu "Here is the sample's server file, unchanged:", từ "unchanged" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Here is the sample's server file, unchanged:", what does "unchanged" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unchanged /ʌnˈtʃeɪndʒd/ (tính từ): giữ nguyên, không thay đổi. Hay gặp trong review: "the API stays unchanged" = API giữ nguyên.
items.explanationEn: unchanged /ʌnˈtʃeɪndʒd/ (adjective): kept exactly as it was. Common in reviews: "the API stays unchanged".

items.question: Trong câu "A safety catch: npm refuses to publish this project to the public registry by accident.", từ "by accident" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A safety catch: npm refuses to publish this project to the public registry by accident.", what does "by accident" (phrase) mean?
options: do vô tình, do nhầm lẫn
items.explanation: by accident /baɪ ˈæk.sɪ.dənt/ (cụm từ): do vô tình, do nhầm lẫn. Trái nghĩa: on purpose (cố ý). Accident còn nghĩa là tai nạn.
items.explanationEn: by accident /baɪ ˈæk.sɪ.dənt/ (phrase): without meaning to. Opposite: on purpose. Accident also means a crash or injury.

items.question: Trong câu "Files use modern import … from '…' syntax (ES modules) instead of the older require().", từ "syntax" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Files use modern import … from '…' syntax (ES modules) instead of the older require().", what does "syntax" (noun) mean?
options: ngữ pháp câu trong tiếng Anh
kết quả khi chạy chương trình
cú pháp (cách viết đúng của ngôn ngữ)
optionsEn: the rules for how code is written
items.explanation: syntax /ˈsɪn.tæks/ (danh từ): cú pháp (cách viết đúng của ngôn ngữ). "Syntax error" = lỗi cú pháp. Trong ngôn ngữ học, syntax là cú pháp câu.
items.explanationEn: syntax /ˈsɪn.tæks/ (noun): the rules for how code is written. "Syntax error" = code written against the rules. In linguistics, syntax is sentence structure.

items.question: Trong câu "Named shortcuts for commands (section 6).", từ "shortcut" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Named shortcuts for commands (section 6).", what does "shortcut" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a quicker way to run something
items.explanation: shortcut /ˈʃɔːt.kʌt/ (danh từ): lối tắt, lệnh tắt. "Keyboard shortcut" = phím tắt. Nghĩa gốc là đường tắt.
items.explanationEn: shortcut /ˈʃɔːt.kʌt/ (noun): a quicker way to run something. "Keyboard shortcut" is a key combination. The literal sense is a shorter path.

items.question: Trong câu "Vite is the kitchen equipment: it serves and bundles the code but is not part of the meal.", từ "equipment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Vite is the kitchen equipment: it serves and bundles the code but is not part of the meal.", what does "equipment" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the tools needed for a job
items.explanation: equipment /ɪˈkwɪp.mənt/ (danh từ): đồ nghề, thiết bị. Danh từ không đếm được: "some equipment", không nói "an equipment".
items.explanationEn: equipment /ɪˈkwɪp.mənt/ (noun): the tools needed for a job. Uncountable: "some equipment", never "an equipment".

items.question: Trong câu "Vite is the kitchen equipment: it serves and bundles the code but is not part of the meal.", từ "bundle" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Vite is the kitchen equipment: it serves and bundles the code but is not part of the meal.", what does "bundle" (verb) mean?
options: bán kèm với giá ưu đãi
đóng gói, gom lại thành một khối
optionsEn: to sell together at a discount
to pack together into one unit
items.explanation: bundle /ˈbʌn.dəl/ (động từ): đóng gói, gom lại thành một khối. Danh từ: bundle (gói, bó). Kết quả build ở client gọi là "the bundle".
items.explanationEn: bundle /ˈbʌn.dəl/ (verb): to pack together into one unit. Noun: a bundle. The client build output is called "the bundle".

items.question: Trong câu "Almost every package uses semantic versioning (SemVer): MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH.", từ "semantic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Almost every package uses semantic versioning (SemVer): MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH.", what does "semantic" (adjective) mean?
options: theo ngữ nghĩa, mỗi phần mang một ý nghĩa
items.explanation: semantic /sɪˈmæn.tɪk/ (tính từ): theo ngữ nghĩa, mỗi phần mang một ý nghĩa. Semantic versioning: mỗi con số (MAJOR, MINOR, PATCH) nói lên loại thay đổi. "Semantic HTML" = HTML đúng ngữ nghĩa.
items.explanationEn: semantic /sɪˈmæn.tɪk/ (adjective): relating to meaning. Semantic versioning: each number tells the kind of change. "Semantic HTML" uses tags for their meaning.

items.question: Trong câu "The symbol in front of the version in package.json is a range: which future versions npm is allowed to install.", từ "range" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The symbol in front of the version in package.json is a range: which future versions npm is allowed to install.", what does "range" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a set of values between limits
items.explanation: range /reɪndʒ/ (danh từ): khoảng, phạm vi giá trị. "Version range" = khoảng phiên bản. "A range of" = nhiều loại khác nhau.
items.explanationEn: range /reɪndʒ/ (noun): a set of values between limits. "Version range" = the versions allowed. "A range of" also means a variety of.

items.question: Trong câu "Real evidence from the sample: package.json asks for "express": "^5.1.0", and the lock file recorded that 5.2.1 was actually installed.", từ "evidence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Real evidence from the sample: package.json asks for "express": "^5.1.0", and the lock file recorded that 5.2.1 was actually installed.", what does "evidence" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: material shown in a court case
facts that show something is true
items.explanation: evidence /ˈev.ɪ.dəns/ (danh từ): bằng chứng. Không đếm được: "a piece of evidence". BA đính kèm evidence (ảnh chụp, log) vào bug report.
items.explanationEn: evidence /ˈev.ɪ.dəns/ (noun): facts that show something is true. Uncountable: "a piece of evidence". BAs attach evidence (screenshots, logs) to bug reports.

items.question: Trong câu "One exception to remember: for 0.x versions the caret is stricter (^0.2.3 accepts 0.2.9 but not 0.3.0), because before 1.0 every minor release may break things.", từ "exception" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One exception to remember: for 0.x versions the caret is stricter (^0.2.3 accepts 0.2.9 but not 0.3.0), because before 1.0 every minor release may break things.", what does "exception" (noun) mean?
options: lỗi phát sinh khi chạy code
optionsEn: a case that does not follow the rule
an error thrown while code runs
items.explanation: exception /ɪkˈsep.ʃən/ (danh từ): ngoại lệ. Trong lập trình, exception còn là "lỗi ném ra" (throw an exception). Ở đây là ngoại lệ của quy tắc.
items.explanationEn: exception /ɪkˈsep.ʃən/ (noun): a case that does not follow the rule. In programming an exception is also an error that is thrown. Here it is a case outside the rule.

items.question: Trong câu "One exception to remember: for 0.x versions the caret is stricter (^0.2.3 accepts 0.2.9 but not 0.3.0), because before 1.0 every minor release may break things.", từ "strict" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One exception to remember: for 0.x versions the caret is stricter (^0.2.3 accepts 0.2.9 but not 0.3.0), because before 1.0 every minor release may break things.", what does "strict" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: strict /strɪkt/ (tính từ): chặt chẽ, nghiêm ngặt. So sánh hơn: stricter. "Strict mode" trong JavaScript = chế độ nghiêm ngặt.
items.explanationEn: strict /strɪkt/ (adjective): allowing little freedom. Comparative: stricter. JavaScript has a "strict mode".

items.question: Trong câu "SemVer is a promise, not a guarantee.", từ "guarantee" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "SemVer is a promise, not a guarantee.", what does "guarantee" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a firm assurance that something will happen
items.explanation: guarantee /ˌɡær.ənˈtiː/ (danh từ): sự bảo đảm chắc chắn. Động từ cùng dạng: to guarantee (bảo đảm). "No guarantee" = không có gì chắc chắn.
items.explanationEn: guarantee /ˌɡær.ənˈtiː/ (noun): a firm assurance that something will happen. Same-form verb: to guarantee. "No guarantee" means nothing is certain.

items.question: Trong câu "Your change disappears on the next install.", từ "disappear" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Your change disappears on the next install.", what does "disappear" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to stop existing or being visible
items.explanation: disappear /ˌdɪs.əˈpɪər/ (động từ): biến mất. Trái nghĩa: appear. Tester hay viết "the message disappears after 3 seconds".
items.explanationEn: disappear /ˌdɪs.əˈpɪər/ (verb): to stop existing or being visible. Opposite: appear. Testers write "the message disappears after 3 seconds".

items.question: Trong câu "It is a cache, rebuilt from package.json plus the lock file.", từ "cache" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is a cache, rebuilt from package.json plus the lock file.", what does "cache" (noun) mean?
options: bộ nhớ đệm (bản lưu tạm để dùng nhanh)
optionsEn: a stored copy kept for quick reuse
items.explanation: cache /kæʃ/ (danh từ): bộ nhớ đệm (bản lưu tạm để dùng nhanh). Phát âm giống "cash". "Clear the cache" = xóa bộ nhớ đệm. Nghĩa gốc: nơi cất giấu.
items.explanationEn: cache /kæʃ/ (noun): a stored copy kept for quick reuse. Pronounced like "cash". "Clear the cache" is a common fix. The older sense is a hidden store.

items.question: Trong câu ""Delete node_modules and install again" is the IT equivalent of "turn it off and on again", and it fixes a surprising number of problems.", từ "equivalent" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence ""Delete node_modules and install again" is the IT equivalent of "turn it off and on again", and it fixes a surprising number of problems.", what does "equivalent" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: something with the same value or role
items.explanation: equivalent /ɪˈkwɪv.əl.ənt/ (danh từ): thứ tương đương. Cũng dùng như tính từ: "equivalent to" = tương đương với.
items.explanationEn: equivalent /ɪˈkwɪv.əl.ənt/ (noun): something with the same value or role. Also an adjective: "equivalent to" = equal in value or role.

items.question: Trong câu "The lock file is the exact receipt of what was installed: every package, including transitive ones, with its precise version, download URL and an integrity checksum.", từ "receipt" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The lock file is the exact receipt of what was installed: every package, including transitive ones, with its precise version, download URL and an integrity checksum.", what does "receipt" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a written record of what was received
items.explanation: receipt /rɪˈsiːt/ (danh từ): hóa đơn, biên nhận. Chữ "p" câm: /rɪˈsiːt/. "On receipt of" = khi nhận được. Đừng nhầm với recipe (công thức).
items.explanationEn: receipt /rɪˈsiːt/ (noun): a written record of what was received. The "p" is silent. "On receipt of" = when received. Do not confuse with recipe.

items.question: Trong câu "The lock file is the exact receipt of what was installed: every package, including transitive ones, with its precise version, download URL and an integrity checksum.", từ "precise" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The lock file is the exact receipt of what was installed: every package, including transitive ones, with its precise version, download URL and an integrity checksum.", what does "precise" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: precise /prɪˈsaɪs/ (tính từ): chính xác, cụ thể. Danh từ: precision (độ chính xác). BA nên viết requirement precise, không mơ hồ.
items.explanationEn: precise /prɪˈsaɪs/ (adjective): exact and clearly defined. Noun: precision. Requirements should be precise, not vague.

items.question: Trong câu "The lock file is the exact receipt of what was installed: every package, including transitive ones, with its precise version, download URL and an integrity checksum.", từ "integrity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The lock file is the exact receipt of what was installed: every package, including transitive ones, with its precise version, download URL and an integrity checksum.", what does "integrity" (noun) mean?
options: tính toàn vẹn (không bị sửa đổi)
optionsEn: the state of being whole and unaltered

items.explanationEn: newcomer /ˈnjuː.kʌm.ər/ (noun): a person who has recently arrived or joined. Similar: new joiner. "Onboarding a newcomer" = helping them settle in.

items.explanationEn: double as /ˈdʌb.əl æz/ (phrase): to have a second use or role as. Example: "The sofa doubles as a bed." On its own, double means to multiply by two.

items.explanationEn: disagree /ˌdɪs.əˈɡriː/ (verb): to not match or be consistent. Of data: two sources that disagree do not match. Of people: to hold different opinions.

items.explanation: drift apart /drɪft əˈpɑːt/ (cụm từ): dần dần lệch xa nhau. Drift = trôi. "Configuration drift" = cấu hình giữa các môi trường lệch dần.
items.explanationEn: drift apart /drɪft əˈpɑːt/ (phrase): to slowly become more different. Drift = to float slowly. "Configuration drift" = environments slowly becoming different.

items.question: Trong câu "Newer projects often pin the tool itself with a "packageManager": "yarn@…" field in package.json; a helper called corepack reads that field and runs the right version.", từ "pin" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: pin /pɪn/ (verb): to fix to one exact version. "Pin a version" = lock it to one exact version. The everyday sense is to fasten with a pin.

items.explanationEn: leave out /liːv aʊt/ (phrase): to not include. Synonyms: omit, exclude. "Don't leave anyone out" = include everyone.

items.explanationEn: gain /ɡeɪn/ (verb): to get something added. Opposite: lose. "Gain experience" = build up experience.

items.explanationEn: hash /hæʃ/ (noun): a fixed-length fingerprint of data. The sample stores passwords as bcrypt hashes. The # symbol is also called hash.

safe to throw away and recreate

items.explanationEn: disposable /dɪˈspəʊ.zə.bəl/ (adjective): safe to throw away and recreate. "Disposable income" is money left to spend. Here: can be deleted and recreated any time.

items.explanationEn: a handful of /ə ˈhænd.fʊl əv/ (phrase): a small number of. Literally as much as a hand holds. "A handful" alone can mean someone hard to control.

items.question: Trong câu "Windows PowerShell blocks script files by default", từ "by default" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: by default /baɪ dɪˈfɔːlt/ (phrase): automatically, unless changed. In finance, default means failing to pay. "Default value" = the preset value.

items.explanation: incompatible /ˌɪn.kəmˈpæt.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): không tương thích. Trái nghĩa: compatible. "Backward compatible" = tương thích ngược.
items.explanationEn: incompatible /ˌɪn.kəmˈpæt.ə.bəl/ (adjective): unable to work together. Opposite: compatible. "Backward compatible" = works with older versions.

items.explanationEn: last resort /lɑːst rɪˈzɔːt/ (phrase): the option used only when all else fails. "As a last resort" = when nothing else works. Resort also means a holiday place.

items.explanationEn: fetch /fetʃ/ (verb): to go and get data from somewhere. JavaScript's fetch() calls APIs. "Fetch a price" also means to sell for an amount.

items.explanationEn: paste /peɪst/ (verb): to insert copied text. Common pair: copy and paste. The noun paste means a soft glue or mixture.

items.explanationEn: beware /bɪˈweər/ (verb): to be careful of a danger. Usually an imperative: "Beware of the dog".

items.explanationEn: steal /stiːl/ (verb): to take without permission. Past: stole, stolen. "Credential stealing" = taking login details.

items.explanationEn: maintained /meɪnˈteɪnd/ (adjective): still being looked after and updated. Noun: maintainer. Opposite: unmaintained, abandoned.

items.explanationEn: handy /ˈhæn.di/ (adjective): useful and convenient. "Come in handy" = turn out to be useful. "Handy with tools" = skilful.

items.question: Trong câu "It checks your installed versions against a database of known vulnerabilities.", từ "vulnerability" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: vulnerability /ˌvʌl.nər.əˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (noun): a weakness that attackers can exploit. Common short form: vuln. Each public vulnerability gets a CVE id.

items.explanationEn: rely on /rɪˈlaɪ ɒn/ (phrase): to depend on. Adjective: reliable. Noun: reliability.

items.explanationEn: deserve /dɪˈzɜːv/ (verb): to be worth receiving. Common: "deserve attention".

items.question: Trong câu "MIT, ISC and Apache-2.0 are permissive; GPL-style licences can oblige a company to publish its own source code.", từ "permissive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: permissive /pəˈmɪs.ɪv/ (adjective): allowing a lot of freedom. A "permissive licence" allows nearly free use, mostly just keeping the copyright notice.

items.explanationEn: oblige /əˈblaɪdʒ/ (verb): to force by law or rule. Noun: obligation. "Much obliged" = thank you very much.

items.explanation: enterprise /ˈen.tə.praɪz/ (danh từ): doanh nghiệp (quy mô lớn). "Enterprise software" = phần mềm cho doanh nghiệp. Nghĩa khác: sự táo bạo, óc kinh doanh.
items.explanationEn: enterprise /ˈen.tə.praɪz/ (noun): a large business organisation. "Enterprise software" serves large companies. Another sense: initiative and boldness.

items.question: Trong câu "Packages are reusable ingredients downloaded from the npm registry by a package manager (npm, yarn or pnpm).", từ "reusable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Packages are reusable ingredients downloaded from the npm registry by a package manager (npm, yarn or pnpm).", what does "reusable" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: able to be recycled as waste
items.explanation: reusable /ˌriːˈjuː.zə.bəl/ (tính từ): dùng lại được. "Reusable component" = component dùng lại được ở nhiều màn hình.
items.explanationEn: reusable /ˌriːˈjuː.zə.bəl/ (adjective): able to be used again. A "reusable component" can appear on many screens.

items.question: Trong câu "package.json lists what a project needs and how to run it; the lock file records exactly what was installed; node_modules is a disposable, never-committed copy of it all.", từ "record" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "package.json lists what a project needs and how to run it; the lock file records exactly what was installed; node_modules is a disposable, never-committed copy of it all.", what does "record" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to write down or store for later
items.explanation: record /rɪˈkɔːd/ (động từ): ghi lại, lưu lại. Động từ nhấn âm sau /rɪˈkɔːd/; danh từ nhấn âm đầu /ˈrek.ɔːd/ (bản ghi, kỷ lục).
items.explanationEn: record /rɪˈkɔːd/ (verb): to write down or store for later. The verb stresses the second syllable; the noun /ˈrek.ɔːd/ stresses the first.

items.question: Trong câu "Check your environment with node -v and npm -v and explain what LTS means", từ "environment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Check your environment with node -v and npm -v and explain what LTS means", what does "environment" (noun) mean?
options: môi trường (cài đặt và công cụ trên máy)
optionsEn: the setup of software on a machine
items.explanation: environment /ɪnˈvaɪ.rən.mənt/ (danh từ): môi trường (cài đặt và công cụ trên máy). Trong IT: dev, staging, production environment. "Environment variable" = biến môi trường.
items.explanationEn: environment /ɪnˈvaɪ.rən.mənt/ (noun): the setup of software on a machine. In IT: dev, staging and production environments. "Environment variable" = a setting passed to a program.

items.question: Trong câu "Read a package.json and tell dependencies from devDependencies", từ "tell … from" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Read a package.json and tell dependencies from devDependencies", what does "tell … from" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to see the difference between two things
items.explanation: tell … from /tel frɒm/ (cụm từ): phân biệt … với …. Cấu trúc: tell A from B = phân biệt A với B. Đồng nghĩa: distinguish A from B.
items.explanationEn: tell … from /tel frɒm/ (phrase): to see the difference between two things. Pattern: tell A from B. Synonym: distinguish A from B.

items.question: Trong câu "Explain why the lock file is committed and node_modules is not", từ "commit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Explain why the lock file is committed and node_modules is not", what does "commit" (verb) mean?
options: lưu thay đổi vào lịch sử Git
optionsEn: to save changes into Git history
items.explanation: commit /kəˈmɪt/ (động từ): lưu thay đổi vào lịch sử Git. Danh từ cùng dạng: a commit. Nghĩa khác: commit to (cam kết), commit a crime (phạm tội).
items.explanationEn: commit /kəˈmɪt/ (verb): to save changes into Git history. Same-form noun: a commit. Other senses: commit to (pledge), commit a crime.

items.question: Trong câu "Recognise the common install errors and attach useful details to a bug report", từ "recognise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Recognise the common install errors and attach useful details to a bug report", what does "recognise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: recognise /ˈrek.əɡ.naɪz/ (động từ): nhận ra, nhận diện. Kiểu Mỹ: recognize. Danh từ: recognition.
items.explanationEn: recognise /ˈrek.əɡ.naɪz/ (verb): to identify something known. US spelling: recognize. Noun: recognition.

items.question: Trong câu "Recognise the common install errors and attach useful details to a bug report", từ "attach" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Recognise the common install errors and attach useful details to a bug report", what does "attach" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to add as an extra part
items.explanation: attach /əˈtætʃ/ (động từ): đính kèm. Danh từ: attachment (file đính kèm). "Be attached to" = gắn bó với. Đừng nhầm với attack.
items.explanationEn: attach /əˈtætʃ/ (verb): to add as an extra part. Noun: attachment. "Be attached to" = fond of. Do not confuse with attack.

items.question: Trong câu "Treat a library upgrade and a new dependency as work with risk, licence and test impact", từ "treat … as" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Treat a library upgrade and a new dependency as work with risk, licence and test impact", what does "treat … as" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to regard or handle something as
items.explanation: treat … as /triːt æz/ (cụm từ): coi … là …, xem … như …. Treat còn nghĩa là chữa trị, hoặc chiêu đãi ("my treat" = tôi mời).
items.explanationEn: treat … as /triːt æz/ (phrase): to regard or handle something as. Treat also means to give medical care, or to pay for someone ("my treat").

items.question: Trong câu "Treat a library upgrade and a new dependency as work with risk, licence and test impact", từ "impact" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Treat a library upgrade and a new dependency as work with risk, licence and test impact", what does "impact" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: impact /ˈɪm.pækt/ (danh từ): tác động, ảnh hưởng. "Impact analysis" = phân tích ảnh hưởng, việc BA thường làm trước một thay đổi.
items.explanationEn: impact /ˈɪm.pækt/ (noun): an effect or influence. "Impact analysis" = assessing what a change affects, a common BA task.
